verses.text: On the first day of the twelfth month, in the twelfth year, the LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, sing a funeral song for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: 'You think of yourself as a lion among the nations, but you are really like a monster in the seas. You thrash about in your rivers, churning up the water with your feet and making the streams muddy.
This is what the Lord GOD says: With a great crowd of people I will spread my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.
I will throw you on the land and fling you onto the open field. I will let all the birds of the sky settle on you, and the wild animals of the whole earth will eat their fill of you.
I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with what is left of you.
I will soak the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.
When I put out your light, I will cover the sky and darken its stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
I will darken all the shining lights in the sky above you, and I will bring darkness over your land, says the Lord GOD.
I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring news of your destruction among the nations, to countries you have never known.

I will make many peoples shocked at you. Their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I swing my sword in front of them. On the day of your fall, each of them will tremble every moment for his own life.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.
I will make your crowds of people fall by the swords of mighty warriors, the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her crowds of people will be destroyed.
I will destroy all her cattle that graze beside her plentiful waters. No human foot or animal hoof will stir up the water again.
Then I will let her waters settle and make her rivers flow smoothly like oil, says the Lord GOD.
When I make Egypt a wasteland, stripped of everything that filled it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.
This is the funeral song they will sing for her. The women of the nations will sing it. They will sing it for Egypt and all her crowds of people, says the Lord GOD.'"
On the fifteenth day of the month, in the twelfth year, the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, wail for the crowds of Egypt. Send them down to the world below, both her and the daughters of mighty nations, along with those who go down to the pit.
Say to them, 'Are you more beautiful than anyone else? Go down and be laid to rest among the uncircumcised!'
They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn. Let her be dragged away with all her crowds.
From the middle of the grave the mighty leaders will speak about Egypt and her allies: 'They have come down, and they lie among the uncircumcised, killed by the sword.'
Assyria is there with her whole army, surrounded by the graves of all her dead, all who were killed by the sword.
Their graves are in the deepest part of the pit, and her army lies around her grave. All of them were killed by the sword, those who once spread terror in the land of the living.

Elam is there with all her crowds of people around her grave. All of them were killed by the sword. They went down uncircumcised to the world below, those who once spread terror in the land of the living. Now they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

A bed has been made for Elam among the dead, with all her crowds around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because they spread terror in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit. They are laid among the dead.
Meshech and Tubal are there, with all their crowds of people around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword, because they spread terror in the land of the living.

They do not lie with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to the grave with their weapons of war, their swords placed under their heads and their shields on their bones. For the terror of these warriors had spread through the land of the living.
You too, Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.
Edom is there, with her kings and all her leaders. Despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.

All the princes of the north and all the people of Sidon are there. They went down with the dead in shame, despite the terror their power once caused. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
Pharaoh will see them and be comforted for all his crowds of people, Pharaoh and his whole army killed by the sword, says the Lord GOD.
Although I let him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his crowds of people will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, says the Lord GOD."
